name: Bosse Eriksson
biography: has been involved in various security related projects over the past years and has recently been published in Phrack Magazine. He enjoys finding vulnerabilities in various software as well as writing exploits for them, recently focusing on Mac OS X and it's related vulnerabilities. Bosse is currently employed as a security researcher at the Swedish based security company Bitsec where he performs penetration tests, exploit development and vulnerability research.
